snippet.title: WAKFU in High Def!
snippet.description:
Despite the many upheavals it has endured, the World of Twelve has never looked so beautiful! Experience WAKFU in an all-new HD version! 

SUBSCRIBE TO THE CHANNEL: https://www.youtube.com/c/wakfu 

You have asked us for this many times. And we secretly really wanted it too… But we didn't dare. And then, one day, we decided to just go for it!  
Characters, monsters, equipment, resources, interactive elements, pets, mounts and soon environments: WAKFU's graphics have had a little makeover. And that's just the beginning! 
Check it out in the game asap!
HD mode is available in the settings for WAKFU in the Ankama Launcher. HD mode is enabled by default, but you can disable it if you like.

For more information, please refer to the news post announcing these graphics improvements: https://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/announcements/1649437-rediscover-wakfu-high-def?refreshcache=

FOLLOW ALL THE LATEST WAKFU NEWS: https://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/announcements 
FACEBOOK: https://www.facebook.com/wakfu.jeu.fr
TWITTER: https://twitter.com/WAKFU_EN 

#WAKFU
